The high relevance threshold must be at least the medium relevance threshold. The secondary-character mention threshold must be at least the name-only mention threshold. Related characters and terms are added to context according to the configured relation count.
Review how character hits, groups, and term context are calculated.

Aho–Corasick scans character names, aliases, and game terms together.
1. Variables and hit scores speakerTurns: dialogue segments where the character is the current speaker. showHits: times the character portrait appears in the current scene. textHits: sum of character-name and valid-alias hits; a normal hit scores 1, while a name next to katakana on both sides scores 0.1. sceneItemCount: translatable items in the current scene. speakerScore = speakerTurns × 10; showScore = showHits × 2; textScore = textHits. relevance = 5 × ln(1 + speakerTurns) + 2 × ln(1 + showHits) + ln(1 + textHits). density = (speakerScore + showScore + textScore) / sqrt(sceneItemCount).
2. Character groups A character gets a primary full profile when any condition holds: speakerTurns ≥ 2; speakerTurns ≥ 1 and showHits ≥ 1; relevance ≥ HighRelevance; or relevance ≥ MidRelevance and density ≥ DensityHigh. If not primary, textScore ≥ TextLowScore, or textScore > TextMentionedScore and RelatedNum(name, highSet) ≥ RelatedNum, gives a secondary full profile. Otherwise textScore ≥ TextMentionedScore enters mentioned with only the name and translation.
3. Aliases and special names Attach only aliases that actually hit. Alias total score must be ≥ TextMentionedScore. A called restriction must be empty or match the current speaker. An mc conditional nickname also requires dialogue, portrait, or text evidence for the restricted role.
4. Game terms A direct hit scores ≥ TextMentionedScore. A primary character\'s guild, school, and origin_world terms are direct context. Related terms for secondary characters are included when at least LowTermScore secondary characters share them.
